description: Compute tax on an amount for a jurisdiction using a built-in estimate table (or an explicit rate). Pure computation — no credential, no approval. Results are estimates, not tax advice.

jurisdiction.description: e.g. US-NY, US-CA, GB, DE, FR, CA, AU — or CUSTOM with tax_rate.

tax_inclusive.description: True if the amount already includes tax (back it out). Default false.

tax_rate.description: Decimal fraction 0–1 overriding the table, or required with CUSTOM.

name: calc_tax
provider_notes: No provider. Built-in estimate table (2026-09) + Decimal half-up math. Not tax advice.
